annotations.title: Discover what The Living Bread offers for a need, in the person's own words

description: The front door: turns a request in the person's own words and language into the need underneath and the real experiences that meet it. Use whenever you are unsure which tool fits ("I feel alone", "I just moved"). Example: {query:"I just moved and want friends who share my faith"}. Full guide: living-bread://tools/discover_living_bread. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.
